notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Account: HavenBridge provides PCI/PHI-sensitive payment support for ambulatory networks. Heavy compliance profile.
- Primary ask: agent-assist + realtime ticket summarization + tool-calling into internal case systems (ServiceNow) without exfiltration of PHI.
- Deployment: MUST run in customer VPC or air-gapped on-prem. No PHI can leave their VPC; legal quote: "PHI cannot leave our tenancy, not even tokenized logs".
- SLOs: 99.95% availability for contact flows; p95 latency target <200ms for agent assist suggestions; sustain bursts up to ~10k concurrent sessions during peak billing windows.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to dedicated/reserved capacity for predictable unit economics but CFO wants firm ARR cap before procurement sign-off.
- Model preferences: open to quantized LLMs hosted in Private with KMS. Prefer Redwood routing that falls back to smaller quantized variants during spikes. No outbound third-party APIs.
- Security: SSO/SAML with IdP (Okta), KMS/HSM for keys, full audit logs retained 7+ years, support for retention_policies and data residency (US-only).
- Integration needs: function/tool-calling to ServiceNow + internal billing API; strict RBAC for agents; token-level cost reports required for chargeback.
- POC scope: 6 weeks. Week 2 simulate 2x traffic, Week 4 run large-scale spike test (10k concurrent), Week 6 validate audit logs & retention restore.
- Quote from CTO on 11/17: "We need to prove PHI never leaves our cloud and we can trace every decision back to a log event."
- Open questions: network egress for KV cache, explicit SOW language for PHI handling, retention encryption-at-rest SLA.
- Reference docs: pricing deck + security answers on Drive (links above). Fireflies transcripts available for 11/17 & 12/01.
- Next: security scoping doc from SE (Diego) to legal, then SOW. If legal OK, move to procurement (forecast 2025-02).
